comparison.objective: Carry a ball on a tray, versus fracture and recover four insert tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Dynamic tray stabilization and balance versus coaxial mandrel holding, controlled striking, withdrawal, and fragment search.
comparison.success_condition: Ball remains successfully carried on the tray versus four safe fractures and four recovered fragments.
comparison.reason: The common notion of containment is incidental: one tests transport stability, the other contact-driven fracture and post-fracture recovery. Detailed carry criteria are absent.
